hunt.name: Wardens of the Tower
hunt.text: Mozella's researchers can't study the Tower of the Giants while its wardens roam the halls. Thin them out inside the Cruma Tower and I'll pay for every one you put down. Mind the Gate of Time and Space: it won't open for anyone of level 56 or above.
Splendid. The tower's gatekeeper is Mozella, at its foot in the Cruma Marshlands. Come back to me in Dion whenever you like - I keep count.
Back from the tower? The expedition's notes grow thicker with every warden that falls.
The halls will be quieter for my colleagues. Here is the expedition's pay.
Researcher Velmor of the Ivory Tower expedition in Dion heard you've been fighting the tower's wardens. He pays for that kind of work.

hunt.name: Ghost Fires of the Mirrors
hunt.text: The ghosts of the Forest of Mirrors carry cold fires that never go out. The cathedral of Aden lights its lamps for the dead with them. Bring me every ghost fire you can take from them.
Take care - the forest plays tricks on the eyes. Bring the ghost fires to me here in Aden; I pay for each one.
Do you carry the ghost fires? Their light is the only thing that keeps the restless dead from the city.
Cold, and still burning... The lamps will be lit for another month. Here is your pay.
Lamplighter Odessa of the Aden cathedral needs the ghost fires the forest's spirits carry, and she saw you hunting them.

hunt.name: Medals of the Fallen
hunt.text: The Vanor Silenos loot the old battlefields of the Plains of Glory - and the medals of the fallen with them. Take those medals back. The soldiers' families pay to have them home, and so do I.
My thanks. The Silenos camp all over the plains west of here. Bring the medals to me in Hunters Village, as many as you find.
Any medals? Every one is a name somebody remembers.
These go back to the families. The guild pays what it promised.
Veteran Halvard of the Old Soldiers' Guild in Hunters Village pays for the medals the Vanor Silenos stole from the fallen.

hunt.name: Vouchers of the Old War
hunt.text: Ratmen and grave robbers on the War-Torn Plains strip the vouchers off the soldiers buried there. Each voucher you bring back is a pension the Veterans' Office can finally pay out.
Good. The plains lie north-east of the village. Bring the vouchers to me here; I pay for every one.
Vouchers? The widows have waited long enough.
Every one of these is a pension paid. Here is the office's fee.
Quartermaster Brenna of the Veterans' Office in Hunters Village needs the war vouchers the plains' thieves carry.

hunt.name: The Canyon Road
hunt.text: The Tanor Silenos and the Nightmare Lords of Tanor Canyon raid every caravan on the canyon road. The Road Watch pays a bounty for each of them you put down.
The canyon is south-west of Giran. Report back to me here whenever you like; the bounty stands.
The caravans still won't take the canyon road. How many have you put down?
The road is a little safer. The bounty, as promised.
Warden Kessler of the Giran Road Watch pays a bounty on the canyon's raiders - and you've been taking them down already.

hunt.name: Bones for the Burial
hunt.text: The dead of the Cemetery won't lie still, and every one you put down leaves its bones on unhallowed ground. Gather them in jars and bring them to me - I'll see them buried properly, and pay for your trouble.
May the goddess keep you. The Cemetery lies east of the village. Bring the jars here; I pay for each.
More bones for the burial? The dead don't rest until they're in hallowed ground.
They'll rest now. Here - for every jar you carried.
Gravekeeper Mirela of Hunters Village wants the bones of the Cemetery's dead brought home for burial.

hunt.name: Taking Back the Falls
hunt.text: The Harit lizardmen have taken Anghel Waterfall, and our hunters can't get near the falls. The lodge pays for every lizardman you drive out - matriarchs included.
The falls are east of Aden. Come back to me here and the lodge pays for every kill.
How many of the lizardmen have you put down at the falls?
The lodge's hunters will thank you. Your pay.
Tracker Joanne of the Aden Hunters' Lodge pays for every Harit lizardman driven from Anghel Waterfall.

hunt.name: The Forsaken Frontier
hunt.text: Every week something new crawls out of the Forsaken Plains towards the village - fallen orcs, drakes, worse. The Watch pays for every beast you put down out there.
The plains are south-east of here. Report to me whenever you like; the Watch keeps count.
Still holding the frontier? How many this time?
The village sleeps better. The Watch's pay.
Sergeant Dorrick of the Hunters Village Watch pays for every beast put down on the Forsaken Plains.

hunt.name: Relics of the Valley
hunt.text: The creatures of Splendor that haunt the Valley of Saints hoard the old statues of the goddess from its ruined shrines. Bring them back to the cathedral - each one is worth its weight to us.
The valley lies far to the north-east of Rune. Bring the statues to me here, as many as you can carry.
Have you found more of the goddess's statues?
Another shrine restored. The cathedral pays its debt.
Sister Aurelie of the Rune Cathedral wants the goddess's statues the valley's creatures hoard, and she pays well.

hunt.name: Fire in the Swamp
hunt.text: The Hames orcs of the Blazing Swamp gather for something, and the swamp's beasts with them. The garrison wants their numbers down before they march - and pays for every one you burn.
The swamp is south of Goddard. Report to me here whenever you like; the garrison keeps count.
Back from the swamp? How many this time?
Fewer of them to march on Goddard. The garrison's pay.
Captain Rhodric of the Goddard garrison pays for every orc and beast put down in the Blazing Swamp.
